brief:
Mohammed Adnan Bashir, a young man from Deir al-Balah in central Gaza, died from wounds he sustained in an Israeli airstrike several months prior, local sources reported to Shehab Wire. Bashir had endured prolonged medical complications from injuries inflicted during the bombing in the southern part of the city before succumbing to his condition.

The death underscores the ongoing toll of prior strikes in Gaza, where Palestinians continue to die from untreated or inadequately managed wounds long after initial attacks. Medical facilities across the territory remain severely damaged and under strain, limiting capacity to provide sustained care for the injured. Bashir's case reflects a broader pattern of delayed fatalities stemming from earlier bombardments across the besieged enclave.
